editorial:
Imagine waking up and seeing ghosts that won't leave you alone. That is exactly what happens to the main character in this spooky ride. She is terrified and confused, so she teams up with a professor who studies psychic powers to figure out why these spirits are attacking. The vibe is very much like those old-school scary movies where the mystery builds up slowly, and you feel the tension rise every time a door creaks or a shadow moves. It feels like a classic campfire story come to life on your screen.

You will probably notice that the acting is a bit dramatic, but that actually adds to the charm of the film. The best part is how the mystery unfolds, though the pacing can feel a little slow in the middle. If you love retro horror with a bit of a detective twist, you should definitely give this a try. You can grab a digital rental on Apple TV for a quick movie night, or if you are a fan of physical media, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your collection is the best way to see all the dark details clearly.
endingExplained: Everything comes down to a dark secret from the past. You find out that a mean spirit is looking for revenge against the people who wronged it long ago. After a big showdown, the professor and the woman use their knowledge to stop the ghost for good. They manage to break the connection between the living and the dead, which finally lets the spirits rest and saves the main characters from being killed.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 80s ghost stories and supernatural mysteries.
